title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests a change in the model's complexity. Consider how reducing the number of features might affect the model's ability to generalize.

title: Feature Selection Impact
text: By selecting only $$10$$ features, the model becomes simpler. A simpler model might not fit the training data as well, leading to increased training error. However, it might generalize better to unseen data, reducing validation error.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: The increase in training error and decrease in validation error is indicative of the bias-variance tradeoff. A simpler model has higher bias but lower variance, which can lead to better generalization.
